newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hoechst shares drop as HMR listing dropped.
newsitem.headline: Hoechst shares drop as HMR listing dropped.

text.p: Shares in German chemicals and drugs group Hoechst AG slumped more than four percent on Wednesday as news that the company had shelved plans to list its HMR unit weighed on the shares.
Hoechst hit a low of 71.91 marks, a drop of over four percent, before recovering slightly to trade down 3.8 percent at 72.35 marks at 0833 GMT.
The IBIS DAX index was up 5.13 points, or 0.15 percent, at 3,436.08 points.
Dealers said the market was surprised and disappointed at the news that Hoechst no longer planned to list HMR, as had been widely expected.
